resources.string: In Accessibility Settings, open Downloaded apps or Installed services, select Screenly, and turn on Use Screenly. Return here to check the status.

After enabling the service, open Android Settings. Tap the floating Screenly bubble, then Guide Me, and enter a goal such as How do I change my font size? Manually tap the highlighted control; Screenly will check the next screen. Open Guide Me to recheck, stop, confirm completion, or use the manual picker. Drag the bubble to move it. Only diagnostic counts and timings are logged.

Screen observations stay in memory. Screenshots are processed only during authorized guidance or questions. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped; editable values are omitted. Screenly does not save screen contents, use the network, or tap for you.

Inspects accessible interface elements in other apps and displays a floating assistant for manual highlighting. Private text and images are not logged. Password and sensitive nodes are skipped, and editable values are omitted. No screen contents are uploaded; Screenly never taps for you.
Screenly assistant. Tap to open actions; drag to move.
On-device AI chat is not available in this prototype yet. Use Guide Me to manually select and highlight controls.
AI screen explanations are not implemented yet. Guide Me can highlight a selected control without tapping it for you.
No enabled clickable elements are available on this screen. Close the picker and navigate to another screen.
The screen changed. Open the picker again to select a current element.
What would you like to do?
How do I change my font size?
Waiting for an accessible screen. Open the relevant application.
Checking this screen on your device…
I couldn\'t identify the correct button on this screen. Try opening the relevant menu, then ask me again.
Local AI is unavailable, and I couldn\'t verify a next step. Open the relevant menu or use the manual picker.
You confirmed that your goal is complete.
The image model is not installed.
The image model has not passed device verification.
Screenshot processing is blocked on this private or editable screen.
Image inference is unavailable on this device.
Android could not provide a current screenshot.
The screen changed while Screenly was checking it. Wait for it to settle, then ask again.
Capturing this screen. Please wait a moment before browsing.
Screen captured. You can browse while local AI thinks. Screenly will reopen the original app when the answer is ready.
Accessibility snapshot captured; screenshot unavailable. You can browse while text-only AI thinks. Screenly will reopen the original app when the answer is ready.
Captured screen preview. Read-only; these controls cannot be tapped.
This answer describes the captured screen. Reopening the app cannot undo changes to its page or scroll position. Use Guide Me for fresh control highlights.
Android could not reopen the original app. You can return to it manually.
Import the exact supported model files after accepting their license. Imports stay on your device.
Image model verified and installed. Native device verification is still required before use.
Model import failed. Choose the exact supported artifact and check available storage. The previous model was preserved.
Explain the purpose of this screen and its visible controls.
AI thinks this goal is complete. Please confirm using I completed my goal.
Increase the value of %1$s toward its maximum.
Decrease the value of %1$s toward its minimum.
Scroll forward in %1$s to reveal more controls.
Scroll backward in %1$s to reveal earlier controls.
AI thinks the visible screen satisfies your goal.
A little help, right when you need it.
Not sure what to tap next? Ask Screenly, understand what is on your screen, or follow simple step-by-step guidance.
Check which Screenly features are ready to use.
Ready to help while you use other apps.
Allow Accessibility access to show the floating Screenly bubble in other apps.
Gemma 3 1B INT4 is on this phone. Answers run locally without mobile data.
Optional. Basic offline guidance works now; add Gemma for more flexible answers.
Copying and checking your model. Please keep Screenly open.
AI model imported and verified. You can now use on-device answers.
Couldn’t import this model. Choose the official Gemma 3 1B INT4 .litertlm file and try again.
Get help directly in the apps you already use.
Navigate to the screen where you need help.
It floats over other apps once Accessibility access is enabled.
Choose Ask AI, Explain, or Guide Me, then continue at your own pace.
Screenly works without a connection. Recent chats and guides are stored privately on your phone and can be cleared in Privacy.
Made for everyday Android, online or offline.
Gemma 3n image AI is certified for this device. Screenly can interpret permitted captures privately.
An image model is imported, but this device has not passed the required native verification. Text-only help still works.
Optional advanced feature. A separate large Gemma 3n model is needed for screenshot understanding.
